# libreac / fuzz_decode

libreac's own fuzz target `fuzz_decode` ([source](source/fuzz_decode.c), unmodified), which OSS-Fuzz does not run, over libreac 1.9.0 (FreeREAC/libreac at d16f3f4e).

Decodes the payload after its three header bytes as one REAC audio frame, in its own allocation of exactly its length, with libreac's frame decoders: reac_frame_inspect, reac_decode and reac_decode_plain_le downstream, reac_upstream_decode upstream, and the two helpers every ingest path calls first, reac_frame_is_reac and reac_frame_clean_len. The low two bits of byte 0 pick the 44.1, 48 or 96 kHz mode or a geometry built from bytes 1 and 2 read as signed. A rejected frame is an ordinary result.

## How this program differs from a libFuzzer build of this fuzz target
- Linked against a static libreac.a of every src/*.c of libreac 1.9.0 at commit d16f3f4e, compiled with each build's flags, as libreac's Makefile builds its fuzz targets but with this toolchain in place of a native clang and libFuzzer.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the fuzz target one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- Downstream: a frame is valid only as a 1492-byte 0x8819 frame ending C2 EA with its counter at bytes 14-15; reac_decode decodes exactly a valid frame of a fitting even-width geometry and reac_decode_plain_le a valid fitting one, each returning the samples per packet, a refused decode leaves its output untouched, and each plain-LE sample is the straight copy ([lines 152-233](source/fuzz_decode.c#L152-L233)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- Decoding a frame's audio and braiding it again with reac_braid_encode gives back the audio region byte for byte, downstream and upstream, for a geometry of 12 samples or fewer ([lines 118-125](source/fuzz_decode.c#L118-L125)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- Every decoded sample, downstream and upstream, is the three bytes the documented braid map puts it in, the map written out in the harness rather than taken from the library ([lines 88-98](source/fuzz_decode.c#L88-L98)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- Upstream: reac_upstream_channels is the frame's geometry restricted to box widths, NULL arguments are refused, and reac_upstream_decode succeeds exactly on a 0x8819 frame of a box geometry ending C2 EA, leaving its output untouched when it refuses ([lines 251-303](source/fuzz_decode.c#L251-L303)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- reac_frame_is_reac is true exactly for a frame of at least 14 bytes with EtherType 0x8819, and reac_frame_clean_len strips a two-byte FCS residue exactly when the length is two more than a legal geometry, and nothing else ([lines 334-356](source/fuzz_decode.c#L334-L356)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libreac` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_decode.plain` | 47,136 | `556b61e63c44907b003aff8b1e8b926863db277b4f2897fdc58967a7beddc9cc` |

| asan | `fuzz_decode.asan` | 568,552 | `5973b76807d8d2e14b82dc6afde70a2c882923658406aeca43681719cb4e8036` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_decode.asan-ubsan` | 569,992 | `5d05689fd5b196976890b91e68c113953d385775b9d811ef98c712b2cac7d4a9` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
